---
name: Connector request
about: Ask for support for a framework Oryxa hasn't been tested against
title: 'Connector: '
labels: connector
---

**Which framework?** (and a link to its HTTP surface docs, if you have one)

**How does it serve a turn?** Anything you know helps — the endpoint, whether it
streams, whether it has a concept of a conversation/thread id.

**Have you tried writing one?** Not required at all. If you did, paste the YAML
and the output of `oryxa check <name>` and we'll take it from there.

Connectors are one YAML file and no Go — if you'd like to write it yourself,
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) has the three-step version and we're
happy to help in the thread.
